DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP).

The child is a 4-year-old male with frequent epistaxis, gum bleeding, unexplained bruising, and petechiae on the extremities. Given the history of mucous membrane bleeding and petechiae without mention of other systemic symptoms, I am suspecting an isolated thrombocytopenic disorder.
